title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Application for Support of Costs for Upgrading/Consolidation of Hub Stations)
① Any applicant who wishes to receive financial support for upgrading, consolidating, or otherwise modifying hub stations in accordance with Article 3(4) of the "Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railway Logistics Industry" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") must submit an application in Form 1, as shown in Appendix 1, to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.
② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, upon receiving the application as described in Article 1, shall verify the applicant's corporate registration certificate (if the applicant is a corporation) and business registration certificate through the common use of administrative information as stipulated in Article 3(1) of the "Electronic Government Act." However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof shall be attached.
